About Us

Victoria Falls, Zimbabwe

About BeHeard Zimbabwe

BeHeard Zimbabwe is a registered Private Voluntary Organisation based in Victoria Falls, Zimbabwe, dedicated to improving the lives of vulnerable individuals, children, women and families.

Through education, psychosocial support, community empowerment and sustainable livelihood initiatives, we seek to restore hope, promote dignity and create opportunities for individuals to reach their full potential.

We believe that every voice deserves to be heard and every individual deserves an opportunity to thrive, regardless of their background or circumstances.

Our Mission

To empower vulnerable individuals, families and communities through education, psychosocial support, advocacy and sustainable development initiatives that promote dignity, independence and well-being.

Our Vision

A society where every voice is heard, every individual is valued, and everyone has equal opportunities to thrive.

Our Core Values

  • Compassion
  • Integrity
  • Accountability
  • Empowerment
  • Inclusivity
  • Respect and dignity
  • Social justice

Meet Our Founder

Ashley Mutamiri

Ashley Mutamiri is the founder of BeHeard Zimbabwe, a registered social worker who holds a Bachelor of Science degree in Social Work. She studied at Africa University. Furthermore, she is an outstanding public speaker with over 30 championships. She teaches young girls and boys how to speak with confidence.

She is passionate about child protection, community development, psychosocial support and empowering vulnerable individuals.

Her vision for BeHeard Zimbabwe is to create a platform where individuals who are often overlooked can be heard, supported and empowered to build better futures.
